articles.title: Ripple raises $200 million from Neuberger Berman to expand its Ripple Prime platform
articles.snippet: Ripple announced its agreement with the global investment firm Monday, noting that Ripple Prime’s revenue has tripled in the last year, when. it acquired it for $1.25 billion.

articles.title: Ripple Lands $200 Million Financing Facility to Expand Institutional Crypto Brokerage
articles.snippet: The XRP-linked Ripple secures financing from Neuberger Specialty Finance to fuel growth of its prime brokerage platform.
